content:
i started playing league in 2013 when i was a kid. i remember a friend had to come install it for me bc i couldn't figure out how. for a couple years after that league was my life. i woke up in the middle of the night to watch worlds 2014 live. i'd watch lcs vods cuz i didnt know how to watch em live. playing everyday, watching content about it, you know the deal. unsurprisingly, i was quite terrible at it. i've never been good at games in general. i never bothered too much with rank, but when i did, i got low silver high bronze back when that was the lowers tier.

i specifically remember my first ranked game. i couldn't play any ranked in 2013 cuz i didnt owned the required minimum amount of champions. the points system was a nightmare. so 2014 was my year. at the time i insisted on playing mid (ofc) and my main was akali. i remember i had like 4 skins of her. i had this weird relationship with akali though because despite her being my favourite champion i rarely played her (in hindsight i regreat not playing more of old akali), always saved her for 'occasion'. and one such occasion was my very first ranked game.

now this was the old rank system where you coudln't pick a role, you were assigned a (afaik) random order on pick and ban phase. first pick got to choose whatever they wanted, last pick was doomed to support. my first ever ranked game had to be with akali, so i remember dodging 2 or 3 times in order to get first pick. i really dont remember if those counted as losses or not. while i was happy i got to pick akali, i was extremely nervous. it is at this time that i started feeling extremely unwell. i was very nervous throughout this whole thing. this was so important for me, not even school stuff or public speaking got me this nervous at this point. before sitting down to queue i had eaten some leftover chocolate cake. and combined with my nervousness it was doing a number on my stomach.

i remember my very first matches, ashe and miss fortune were on the free rotation so those were the champions i first played. at this point i had never played a pc game like this, so i was blown away by the sound design specifically. the voice acting, the music, the ambience.

i was hooked, i was playing pretty much every day after school. i didnt get to play ranked that season cuz i didn't meet the minimum champion requirement. this was the time of the IP system and getting anything without paying was painfully slow. the old rune system was in place and getting even a single rune page going took a long time. shoutouts to having an ad and ap rune and running those in every single champion. during this time i feel like i got the genuine league experience. we didn't know much about the game so it was a period of Discovery through trial and error. everything went anywhere and the only reason to try new champions was either because they seemed cool or because someone on the enemy team destroyed you on a match.

kennen was the first champions i really enjoyed (before it was cool). i really enjoyed energy champions, cuz ninjas are cool and having something different from mana seemed cool. karate kennen was the first skin i ever wasted my money on. another one i really enjoyed was wukong, funnily enough i had a couple of games where i stomped while he was on free rotation, so after that i told myself i'd buy him next. to this day i have not bought him.

playing bullshit like ap malphite was so much fun too. fizz and prerework Leblanc was fun too. top i'd play garen and old shen. old shen was so funny because if it got to late you could just walk into the enemy team and take no damage. renekton was super fun too. i had a slight jungle phase when i decided i wanted to play a 'skillfull' champion, so i picked up lee sin. to this day, i cannot do an insec. my support phase was mainly thresh. i thought hooking people was so cool, felt so satisfying hitting the one. i look back at these times fondly. this was my segway into anime as explained in my anime history. i was never much of a ranked player.
